bias: CPI premarket — he's keeping it high level. A wild night turned into a boring day: relative strength flipped at the open, YM annihilated, NQ max bid off the 595-635 daily level (now tested multiple times and held — a demand distribution). Buyers still haven't secured the weekly reclaims, but sellers have done nothing except run into a brick wall at 595-635. ES does nothing while NQ and YM disperse around it: took out Monday's low to 38-40 and briefly below the overnight low, and Friday's low still hasn't been tested after a weak Monday and Tuesday. SPY volume at historic lows. He'd think (and hope) ES leaves this range after CPI.
wildcard: 'There is really no excuse for sellers to not see 7815-7820 and even 7806-07' — ES is trapped back inside last week's value after a failed excursion higher, and they still can't get it done. NQ: 815-845 is today's bearish RTH gap; a reclaim traps overnight and Tuesday sellers and probably works back to 951-969. Nearly NQ's entire range is covered by one level or another — 'I don't trade everything level to level.'

brief.happened: Overnight sold to 30604.75; cash opened 30619, LOD 30591.25 at the bell into 595-635, max bid to 30814.75 by 10:00, late-morning pullback low 30635.5, closed 30789. 706-725 was clean S/R intraday. brief.pivot: 30815-30845 — the bearish RTH gap; sellers retain control for the week below it. 706-725 still key (door to 504-546); 672-688 (tweaked from 669-681) is where buyers are still fine; 595-635 is the demand brick wall.
brief.higher: Reclaim 815-845 (caution a LAAF, from 883-906 or otherwise) → traps overnight and Tuesday sellers → buyers work back to at least 951-969. Holds of 706-725 and 672-688 keep buyers fine as long as 706-725 is reclaimed off any hold.
brief.lower: Below 672-688 → retest of 595-635 (LOD 30591.25). It could hold again, but if 672-688 has flipped to firm resistance the risk of 504-546 and 30216.5 is elevated. Sellers still need traction through today's low to see 504-546.
